description: Source code for MCPManager class managing MCP server lifecycle, configuration, capability discovery, and skill generation in a Go project.

classes.name: MCPManager
classes.description: Manages MCP server lifecycle, configuration, capability discovery, and skill generation.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new MCP server with configuration, updates YAML, and performs capability discovery.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts an MCP server, either remote or local, and updates its status.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops an MCP server and updates its status.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an MCP server and updates YAML configuration.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the status of all MCP servers.

methods.name: GetProcess
methods.description: Retrieves the process object for a given server alias.

methods.name: Logs
methods.description: Returns a reader for server logs.

methods.name: DiscoverCapabilities
methods.description: Discovers capabilities for an MCP server, either from URL or local process.

methods.name: generateSkills
methods.description: Generates Python skills based on MCP capabilities.
